about: Replay each case against the buffering-quality controller with a fake wall clock. Apply each event at its time t (ms on the case clock), advancing the clock between events so timers fire, then advance to until. expect is the complete ordered list of outputs; any other output fails the case. A case's mode defaults to defaults.mode. buffering_action, when present, is the plan_summary value each listed plan must report. Trigger evaluation occurs on playing and an in-progress long-stall timer, not on waiting or suppression expiry while playing. Suppressed history is retained; timeout and rearm clear it. Plan labels identify local adoptions, not unique server plan IDs; a server plan_id may repeat. Compute the step-down estimate as the exact integer floor of delivered_kbps * 7 / 10. A plan_adopted with controllerInitiated false answers a replan the controller did not send. client_replan has an operation (track_change, seek_reanchor, seek_failure_recovery, failure_recovery or output_change): the client sends a replan for its own reasons, and the output is a replan whose body holds that operation, the adopted plan's quality as quality_preference and, on Auto with a kept step-down estimate, bandwidth_estimate_kbps without bandwidth_estimate_source; the client's other request fields are outside these vectors. quality_changed is a quality change the controller did not send, such as the viewer's pick; it has no fields, and the new quality arrives with the next plan_adopted. new_attempt is a new playback attempt of the same title that the viewer did not choose; it has no fields, and it discards the kept estimate and nothing else: the answer, the once-per-title notice and the re-offer wait belong to the title. A plan_adopted without controllerInitiated that follows the controller's own replan answers it. A waiting with cause renderer began with more than RENDERER_WAIT_BUFFER_MS of media buffered past the playhead: the decoder or renderer is behind, so it is not a stall. A plain waiting during a renderer wait means the media buffered past the playhead fell to RENDERER_WAIT_BUFFER_MS or less, and the stall begins then.

copy.cant_lower: Can't lower quality for this video

cases.name: grace
cases.note: The first stall ends before the grace does, so only one stall counts.

cases.name: slow_start
cases.note: No frame yet, so the grace runs from the first wait.

cases.name: outage
cases.note: The stall is re-timed when transport recovers, so it counts as one 1000 ms stall.

cases.name: lower_again
cases.note: The undo pill times out at 149000; the lower plan keeps playing.

cases.name: picked_quality
cases.note: always still asks about a quality the viewer picked.

cases.name: timeout
cases.note: The second trigger, at 191000, is inside REOFFER_MIN_MS of the first offer.

cases.name: unadopted_replan
cases.note: Rearm counts from the replan at 131000, so the stall at 156000 is ignored and the one at 206000 is not.

cases.name: back_hides_undo_without_answering
cases.note: The undo pill times out at 149000; the lower plan keeps playing.

cases.name: kept_estimate_on_later_replans
cases.note: The client's own Auto replans repeat the lowering's estimate without a source. An adoption the controller did not request keeps it.

cases.name: kept_estimate_replaced_by_next_lowering
cases.note: The undo pills time out at 149000 and 224000.

cases.name: quality_change_discards_kept_estimate
cases.note: The undo pill times out at 149000. The viewer picks 1080p-high, then Auto again.

cases.name: accepted_lower_has_no_reoffer_wait
cases.note: Only a timed-out prompt starts the re-offer wait; an accepted Lower quality does not.

cases.name: reoffer_wait_counts_from_first_display
cases.note: The re-offer wait counts from when the prompt first appeared on screen, not from the trigger that offered it behind another pill.

cases.name: quality_change_ends_reoffer_wait
cases.note: A quality change ends the re-offer wait a timed-out prompt started.

cases.name: undo_timeout_reevaluates_stall_in_progress
cases.note: The undo pill's timer ending during a stall that reached LONG_STALL_MS evaluates it at once.

cases.name: back_on_undo_reevaluates_stall_in_progress
cases.note: Back on the undo pill ends it like its timer: a stall in progress that reached LONG_STALL_MS is evaluated at once.

cases.name: undo_expiry_reevaluates_long_stall
cases.note: An undo pill frozen by a pause expires later; a long stall in progress at its expiry is evaluated then.

cases.name: reoffer_end_during_short_wait_waits_for_playing
cases.note: A suppression that ends during a wait shorter than LONG_STALL_MS evaluates nothing; the next playing does.

cases.name: lowering_result_without_bitrate
cases.note: A lowering's plan with no delivered bitrate counts as lower; it then has no lower rung of its own.

cases.name: failure_notice_spends_cant_lower_once
cases.note: A no-lower result's notice uses up the once-per-title Can't lower quality notice.

cases.name: new_attempt_keeps_the_answer
cases.note: A new attempt of the same title keeps the viewer's Keep quality.

cases.name: new_attempt_keeps_cant_lower_once
cases.note: A new attempt of the same title does not show Can't lower quality again.

cases.name: new_attempt_keeps_the_reoffer_wait
cases.note: A new attempt of the same title keeps the re-offer wait a timed-out prompt started.

cases.name: unrequested_adoption_discards_pending_lowering
cases.note: An adoption the controller did not request drops its pending lowering with no notice; the new plan lowers on its own trigger.

cases.name: startup_wait_then_frame_keeps_grace_anchor
cases.note: A wait before the first frame starts the grace; the frame does not restart it.

cases.name: slow_start_frame_after_grace
cases.note: A start that outlasts the grace counts from its end, and the grace does not run again from the frame.

cases.name: pause_ends_a_stall_uncounted
cases.note: A pause ends a stall in progress without counting it.

cases.name: seek_ends_a_stall_uncounted
cases.note: A seek ends a stall in progress without counting it.

cases.name: pause_and_reload_waits_never_count
cases.note: Waits caused by a pause or a source reload never count, however long.

cases.name: client_replan_keeps_a_picked_quality
cases.note: Off Auto, the client's own replans carry the picked quality and no estimate.

cases.name: ask_lower_keeps_the_estimate
cases.note: Lower quality on Auto in ask keeps its estimate like an automatic lowering: a seek failure recovery carries it.

probe_about: probe_cases replay the speed test arithmetic in Connection speed test > Measuring. chunks are [t, bytes] arrivals in ms after the first byte; a chunk counts in window floor(t / PROBE_WINDOW_MS) and only before the test stops. end is when the client saw the body end cleanly; absent, the transfer ran past the test's limit. A transfer that fails, or ends short of its Content-Length, measured nothing and has no case here. expect is null when the test measured nothing, else {kbps, lower_bound, bytes, duration_ms, stop}, stop being when the client stops reading. connection_budget_cases take current readings only; the reading is the higher of probe_kbps and playback_sample_kbps. When the transfer ends having delivered every byte the mode requests (QUICK_PROBE_BYTES or ACCURATE_PROBE_BYTES) before the first complete window after window 0, the test reports the average over the whole transfer, bytes x 8 / end, with lower_bound true, or the target when a quick test's average reaches it.
